intents.a: Ask how Jim got the letters, who gave them to him, or how he reached me. Jim: Thanks for all your letters. Sorry I never wrote back. The one about Spring Festival, with your grandma's dumplings. I genuinely read that one twice.

Pretend to remember Jim: greet him warmly and say it is nice to hear from him. Jim: Thanks for all your letters. Sorry I never wrote back. The one about Spring Festival, with your grandma's dumplings. I genuinely read that one twice.

Reply coldly: say I do not know him, ask who he is or what he wants, sound distant or suspicious. Jim: Thanks for all your letters. Sorry I never wrote back. The one about Spring Festival, with your grandma's dumplings. I genuinely read that one twice.
